title: Aquaman #15 DC Comics 1995 Peter David Jim Calafiore Kordax
conditionDescription: Light handling wear; back cover has light scuffing. See photos.
descriptionText:
Aquaman #15 (December 1995), DC Comics - vs. Kordax. Peter David story, Jim Calafiore, McKenna and Barnett. Direct sales, $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: Tiger Electronics Batman Forever handheld game ad.

Condition: light handling wear; light scuffing on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
